title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I hope this email reaches you whilst you are in the best of Imaan and health. We run a small charity in the UK. I would like to know a few things regarding interest money. 1. We have a business account in the name of the charity which we use for incoming donations. I would like to know whether it is permissible to open a savings account with the sole intention of generating more interest money. 2. As we have a business account, the bank charges the charity for its services. I would like to know whether it is permissible for us to use interest money which we receive from the bank or interest money which we receive in donations to pay off these bank charges. 3. Is it permissible to use donation interest money to pay off the following, Charity car/van insurance, Business insurance, PAYE Employers tax, Please kindly respond and provide me with the answers to the following questions. May Allah accept your efforts and grant you the best of rewards for your work in this world and in the hereafter. 1439 views Q. I am an American new Muslim. I wanted to know about the new "Islamic insurance called Takaful. I wanted to know if this insurance halaal according to the shariah of Islam? It has been launched in Pakistan and in South Africa and in South Africa most of the ulema say that this "Islamic insurance" is the same as the insurance of the commercial banks because the element of gambling and riba are still present. what is your opinion on this very important matter? Please answer. 1941 views Q. Complicated issue regarding taxes 2803 views Q. I am a student of chartered accountancy, currently undergoing training as an articled assistant in a CA firm in Pune 2496 views Q. Can we use interest money from bank to pay income tax to government? 9222 views Q. Fix Profit 3315 views Q. Home loan to safe income tax 12127 views Q. I have some money in Bank.Please clarify whether I can pay Income tax to the Govt.from the intrest earned on the said money,If not ,then what to do with that money ?.I do not want to leave it to Bank.I pay zakat as per sharia. 2286 views Q. I have a friend of mine who is financially sound&whenever some of my friend including me is in need for money we ask him & he is like bhai if i pay u 10000 rupees for ur business u have to pay me say 12000 in two weeks no matter you profit in that work or you lost but he takes that 12000 is it right for us to pay him that additional amount or for him to take it if we suffer a loss. 1841 views Q. Utilization of Unclaimed huge interest amount lying in the Banks for legal cases of innocent persons who were arrested unduly. 2255 views Q. I am a salaried person and company deducts income tax from our salary and pays it to the goverment. We have to submit a income tax certificate, which company gives us at the end of every financial year, to the goverment. I worked for two companies during April,2005 to March,2006 and I forgot to submit income tax certificate for the first company, althogh my company had deducted income tax from my salary and paid to indian government. I recived a notice from income tax department stating that I had to produce certificate of the first company within 7 days.Although I was late to produce it, but income tax official was demanding money as bribe to accept it and do necessary correction. Initially he was demanding Rs 10,000/- but later on Rs 5,000 was settled. Please let me know whether I can pay this bribe from haram money e.g. bank interest or there is any other way to do it. 2194 views Q. I am an Indian citizen. Can I take education loan from a non-Islamic bank inspite of knowing that I have to give the interest? - I have no other way to fund my higher education (MBA from a Australia). Please do mention any Islamic bank which can give me education loan in an Islamic way for my higher education (MBA) from US/Australia. 4104 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 35621 Country: India Title: Whether it is lawful to give interest money received from provident fund/saving bank account/insurance policy for constructing toilet and bathroom inside the mosque campus Question: Whether it is lawful to give interest money received from provident fund/saving bank account/insurance policy for constructing toilet and bathroom inside the mosque campus. Whether interest money can be given on poor girls marriages? Answer ID: 35621 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2019/B=419/TB=1432) This is impure and haram money. And the right use of haram money is that it should be given in charity to poor and needy ones without the intention of reward in order to save oneself from its curse. It is not lawful to use haram money to build toilet and bathroom in the boundary of Masjid because these things do not involve the option of tamlik. In the marriage of poor girl, make her its owner by giving it in her hands then she can spend it in her marriage expenses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
